text: dsh-rtl-chat 是一款面向 DSH 网页客户端的对话方向插件，帮助使用阿拉伯语的用户以从右向左的方向阅读回答。它在对话标题区域加入 RTL/LTR 切换按钮，并仅对消息滚动区应用 RTL 样式，同时让代码块保持从左向右。用户点击按钮即可切换方向，偏好保存在浏览器本地存储中，刷新后仍可读取。插件适合需要阿拉伯语阅读体验的 DSH 网页用户；需要提供 conversation slot tree 的 Web 客户端，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-rtl-chat adds an RTL/LTR toggle to the DSH web conversation header. It changes the answer area, keeps code left-to-right, and saves the direction in browser storage. For Arabic readers using DSH web; no API key is needed.
我想让 DSH 的回答按阿拉伯语阅读习惯从右往左显示。
DSH 对话内容的方向能不能一键切换成 RTL？
让网页聊天里的答案区适合从右向左阅读。
代码块保持正常方向，同时把对话文字改成 RTL。
Can I switch the conversation answers to right-to-left for reading Arabic?
I need the chat direction preference to stick after I reload the web UI.
dsh-rtl-chat 的功能「对话方向切换」：在对话标题区提供 RTL/LTR 按钮。点击即可在从右向左和从左向右之间切换，适用于对话答案阅读。
dsh-rtl-chat 的功能「代码块方向保护」：切换答案区方向时，pre、code、kbd 和 samp 内容仍使用从左向右的方向，便于继续阅读代码。
dsh-rtl-chat 的功能「记住阅读方向」：启用时读取浏览器本地保存的方向，切换后更新保存值；重新加载时可恢复选择。
网页重新打开后，能继续沿用我选的阅读方向吗？
Keep the answer area RTL while leaving code snippets readable left to right.

@local/dsh-rtl-chat README · dsh-rtl-chat：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) client plugin that makes the **conversation answer area read right-to-left (RTL)** for Arabic, with a one-click button to switch back to left-to-right (LTR).

يعرض منطقة إجابات المحادثة في DeepSeek Harness من اليمين إلى اليسار لقراءة العربية بشكل صحيح، مع زر للتبديل إلى الاتجاه العادي.

@local/dsh-rtl-chat README · Behavior / السلوك：- Only the message/answer scroll area of the conversation panel becomes RTL — the header, sidebar, and app chrome stay LTR.
  يُطبَّق الاتجاه على منطقة الرسائل فقط؛ الترويسة والشريط الجانبي تبقى كما هي.
- Code blocks (`pre`/`code`) inside answers stay LTR so code remains readable.
- A pill button (◄► **RTL**/**LTR**) appears in the conversation header. Clicking it toggles the direction; your choice is persisted in `localStorage` and survives reloads.
  زر دائري في ترويسة المحادثة يبدّل الاتجاه، ويُحفظ اختيارك تلقائيًا.
@local/dsh-rtl-chat README · Install / التثبيت：Requires a DSH web client (profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`) where the conversation slot tree is available.

@local/dsh-rtl-chat README · Install / التثبيت：1. Copy this folder anywhere on disk, e.g. `D:\plugins\dsh-rtl-chat`.
2. In a DSH agent session, ask it to install the bundle:
   ```
   plugin_manager → install_bundle → target: <absolute path to dsh-rtl-chat>
   ```
   or manually: add `"@local/dsh-rtl-chat": "link:<absolute path>"` to the profile's `package.json` dependencies **and** to `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory.
3. Refresh the Web UI once. The button appears in the conversation header and RTL is on by default.
@local/dsh-rtl-chat README · Install / التثبيت：> Note: replacing an already-installed copy of this package requires a DSH server restart; new installs activate live.

@local/dsh-rtl-chat README · Files / الملفات：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest (client half, web platform, injects into the conversation UI) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row that inserts this bundle into a profile composition |
| `index.js` | Host half (no-op; all state lives in the client module) |
| `client.js` | Client half: toggle button, direction state, scoped RTL styles |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon shown in manager UIs |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/ar.json` | Display metadata (title/description) |
